open_items: FD treasure table rolls and Forsaken Depths treasure on monsters remain deferred.
Full citadel dungeon sheet auto-generation and Ru side-dungeon maps remain deferred.
River hazard waste-of-time still uses EE wandering tables until FD wandering table is added.
Oblivion river spell-forget on natural 1 and boat exit blocking remain deferred.

any.description: Complex Precursor machinery fills the chamber.
The foreboding atmosphere triggers a hallucination.
Vermin lurk in the forsaken tunnels.
A Forsaken Depths trap is hidden here.
A boss monster from the Forsaken Depths Boss Table is here.
A weird monster prowls this stretch.
The area is empty. You may Search this space.
Roll on the Forsaken Depths Events Table.
A horde gathers in the depths.

fd_river_hazard_table.result: Waste of Time — navigation takes 20 minutes (two rooms). Roll once for Wandering Monsters.
Damaged Boat — the boat is slightly damaged. A second Damaged Boat result destroys the boat; the party must disembark.
Ambush — riverine creatures attack with surprise. Roll on the Forsaken Depths River Encounter Table.
Ghosts of the River — all characters Save vs. HCL Fear (+½L; cleric-save classes +L). Failure: 1 Madness or −2 Life.
Teleport — the boat jumps to another river stretch on the map. The boatman rolls L8 boating (+L) or the boat is Damaged.
Special Feature — this stretch gains a Cairn, Bridge, or Entrance to a Citadel (even if not printed on the tile).

fd_trap_table.result: Magic Resistant Liquid splashes a random hero — no spells or prayers for six rooms (FD p.58).
Oblivion Trapdoor — lead hero Save or fall; allies may forget them (FD p.58).
Obsidian Disk — all heroes Save (armor/shield apply) or take Tier+2 damage (FD p.58).
Beast Cage — lead hero Save or a surprise Weird Monster attacks (FD p.58).
Soulbinding Trap — rear hero Save or bound to this room until Blessing (FD p.58).
Disintegration Blast — random hero Save or incinerated (FD p.58).
